name: Maker

expectedCapabilities.justification: MKR is minted and burned by the protocol as part of the surplus and debt auction mechanism.

evidence.detail: symbol() = MKR, decimals() = 18, 3379 bytes. Note: MKR returns symbol as bytes32 rather than string, an older ERC-20 convention that naive decoders mishandle.
Maker documents MKR mint and burn in the auction system.

caveats: A live admin behind a timelock is still a live admin.
This entry does not assess governance capture or voting concentration.
The bytes32 symbol encoding is a decoding trap. Recorded here because it breaks naive readers.
